messages:
Sam: Quick sync — planning to toggle the per-tenant batching config during the quiet window on Tue 03/25 at 02:00 UTC. Who can run the deploy and who will own smoke checks? I want to flip to the safe default first (batching=false) and validate for 15m before enabling per-tenant overrides.

Drew: I can do the deploy. I'm available 01:30-03:30 UTC. Will run the smoke script and watch latency + errors. @Maggie can you be backup on metrics? :thumbsup:

Maggie: Yep, I'll be on standby. Will keep an eye on dashboards/traces and confirm SLOs. Link to dashboard in case others need it.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: id=cfg-20260325-ptb, window=2026-03-25T02:00:00Z..2026-03-25T03:00:00Z, owner=Drew

Anya: FYI I'll notify EU customers who have the experimental batching flag enabled. Kevin — can you confirm rollback steps are ready?

Kevin: Rollback plan: if anything looks off, revert to previous config blob with: 
```
./scripts/revert-config.sh cfg-20260325-ptb
# or via console: Configs > per-tenant-batching > Revert to v3
```
I'll be available for 02:00-04:00 UTC. Also pre-seeded the runbook with guardrails (max_error_rate=0.5%, 95p_latency uplift <= 20%).

Sam: Smoke checklist (short):
- run: ./scripts/smoke-batching.sh --env=prod --target=sample-tenant
- verify 95p latency within baseline
- confirm error rate < 0.5% and no new 5xx spikes
- check KV cache hitrate hasn't regressed >5%
- scan logs for NPEs / OOMs for 15m

Drew: I'll paste run output here after flip. If checks pass, enable per-tenant overrides (rolling 10% -> 50% -> 100%) with 10m observation windows. If anything fails, immediate revert + notify #eng-oncall and #product.

Maggie: Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/per-tenant-batching (watch: latency, errors, CPU, GPU util, cache hitrate). I'll create a short gif of the first 5m traces if anything weird shows up.

Anya: Thanks — i'll send the customer note and hold off any broader comm until you confirm green.

Sam: Final call: Drew deploys, Maggie watches metrics, Kevin ready to rollback, Anya handles comms. If no objections, proceed with the plan. :white_check_mark:

Drew: No objections. I'll kick at 02:00 UTC and post updates here.

Maggie: Roger. I'll post :white_check_mark: or :rotating_light:.

Kevin: Copy. Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/per-tenant-batching-revert

Sam: Thanks all — please ping here when the flip starts and after the 15m observation. If anyone needs to change timing, call it out ASAP.
